title: Ya-Sin 36:37-40 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:37-40 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 23. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ (٣٧) وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ (٣٨)

وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ (٣٩) لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ (٤٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

questions.q: Find two heavy and two light raa in 36:37 to 40.
Link 36:38 to 40 to physics: what do we now know about orbits?
questions.a: The sun, moon and planets each follow paths in space; the ayat describe ordered movement long before modern astronomy.
A) swimming. 36:40: 'and each, in an orbit, is swimming.'

questions.q: Ya-Sin 36:38: «وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day; each in an orbit is swimming' (36:40). What does this exact order tell you?
questions.a: Allah's perfect design: everything runs to a measured plan.
